notes: Main-split ABox revision of a stored fact (15 queries), kept from the earlier version and moved to the new layout. Related near uses functional; related far reaches Lincoln by his role, the 16th president (binding; stated with the city in the assassination article's first sentence, so stored). Derived: two compositions through Baltimore (in Maryland; home of Johns Hopkins University) and a binding through the nickname Honest Abe, which is common but rarely used with the assassination. Indeterminate: Ford's Theatre stored under Washington's name or as the theatre of the assassination. The earlier check 'Lincoln was shot in the city where he was assassinated' (missed by Olmo and Mistral) is gone: the w2 bridge now names the assassination itself. The Chinese question now says 'President ... assassinated and died' (遇刺身亡) after two models misread the earlier wording. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama) except those marked approximate. Review fixes: negation now reads "Is it true that ... not ..."; the Ford's Theatre worlds now differ by which belief gives way (the theatre's link to the assassination, or its place), and w2 is marked the weaker world.
